name: Thought Bubble
scaffolding_intent: Displays a pixelated thought bubble above a character, prompting the child to express what that character feels, wants, or plans

parameters.name: bubbleText
parameters.description: '...' (default) or a single word quoted verbatim from the child's utterance. Never an invented thought.

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Size multiplier for the thought bubble

correction_intent: Child attributed a feeling, intention, or thought that the scene contradicts ('he is sad' for a character shown laughing; 'she wants to leave' for a character settling in). Target that character. Do NOT use when the child described a thought or plan instead of a visible action; that is A1 or A2.
suggestion_intent: A character shows a visible emotional or intentional state (facial expression, posture, gesture, reaction to an event) and the child has not said how that character feels, what they want, or what they plan to do. Target that character. Requires visible evidence in the scene.
